WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds != 0 
        THEN CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS REAL)
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT
    s1.MediaTypeId,
    s1.avg_unit_price,
    s1.avg_bytes_per_ms,
    s1.avg_bytes_per_ms - s2.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms as difference
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND s1.avg_bytes_per_ms > s2.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) as final_avg_unit_price,
  AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as final_avg_bytes_per_ms,
  AVG(difference) as final_avg_difference
FROM step3
